sources.snippet: msmarco-MiniLM-L12-en-de-v1 This model is a cross-encoder specifically fine-tuned for document re-ranking tasks across English and German. Developed as part of the Beijing-Ascend ecosystem, it is optimised for deployment on Huawei Ascend NPU hardware via the Modelers.cn platform.
